$description: workledger design tokens (W3C design-tokens format). Single source of truth for color, spacing, radius, type and the one shadow; the palette and scale are docs/design/direction.md, written in code rather than Figma (P7). Synced from Figma variables when a file exists (design spec §14.1). Nothing in apps/web hardcodes a value — the Tailwind preset and the CSS custom properties are both generated from this file by scripts/build-preset.mjs.

color.$description: Semantic roles, one value per theme. `light` is the default; `dark` is applied under prefers-color-scheme: dark. The palette is X's (direction.md §Tokens): true black in dark and white in light, hairlines instead of surfaces, one blue for selection, focus and links, and status hues reserved for status. Values are opaque hex so a Figma round-trip is lossless; `glow` is the one exception, an 8-digit hex the floating shadows read.

subtle-foreground.$description: Tertiary text — counts, durations, identifiers beside a row. X's own secondary grey reads below 4.5:1 on the hover and selected surfaces, and Lighthouse fails every list that carries a count (#134), so these are the nearest values that clear AA against both the page and the selected row.

glow.$description: The soft edge X puts around anything that floats (a menu, the floating panel): grey on white, white on black.

glow.$description: The soft edge X puts around anything that floats (a menu, the floating panel): grey on white, white on black.

spacing.$description: 4px base step on an 8px rhythm, plus the layout constants the Figma frames are measured in: the 232px nav, the 352px right column, the 820px reading body (780px on a session), the 40px list row and the 28px nav row.

radius.$description: The Figma frames' shapes: chips are pills (`full`); `lg` (8px) is a card, a nav row and a button; `xl` (12px) is a right-column module; `md` (6px) is an input.

shadow.$description: One shadow in the whole app, on things that float over the page (the panel when it cannot dock, a menu, a sheet), themed through the `glow` colour.

type.$description: Type scale, tracking and the two families, from the Figma text styles: 12 meta, 13 body, 15 section title, 20 page title. Both faces are bundled with @fontsource-variable and never fetched (design spec §14); the stacks keep the system fallbacks.

leading.$description: Line heights as lengths so a Figma round-trip stays lossless: 16px tight (meta), 20px body, 26px on the 20px page title.

tracking.$description: Letter-spacing of the Figma text styles: body styles -0.6%, titles -1.2%, meta none. Not a Figma variable (text styles carry it), so hand-maintained here.

sans.$value: "Inter Variable", Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

mono.$value: "Roboto Mono Variable", "Roboto Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
